email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your careers page says AT&L is growing in Melbourne and asks civil drafters and designers to send a CV and cover letter to this address, so I am asking about any graduate civil drafter or junior civil designer role in your Melbourne team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office and site work.

Your Amaroo Business Park work in Craigieburn, with roads, stormwater, earthworks and retaining walls, is the kind of civil documentation I want to learn on. My drafting so far is from study, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for a graduate drafting or design role in Melbourne?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: Your careers page says AT&L is growing in Melbourne and invites civil drafters and designers to send a CV and cover letter. This is a speculative enquiry about a graduate civil drafter or junior civil designer role in your Melbourne team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, documenting road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works, reviewing drawings, carrying out inspections and quality checks, and keeping site reports and material records.

Your civil design of roads, stormwater, earthworks and retaining walls at Amaroo Business Park is the kind of work I want to learn on. I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, licence and transport, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My software experience is from study rather than commercial production, so I would start at graduate level.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about any graduate drafting or design opening in Melbourne.
